name: R. R. Reno

lean.basis: Editor of the religious-conservative journal First Things; co-author of the national conservatism statement of principles; author of Return of the Strong Gods: Nationalism, Populism, and the Future of the West (2019).

sources.title: National Conservatism: A Statement of Principles — The American Conservative

summary: R. R. "Rusty" Reno taught theology and ethics at Creighton University from 1990 and has edited the religious journal First Things since the early 2010s, turning it toward national conservatism. He wrote Return of the Strong Gods (2019), co-authored the National Conservatism statement of principles, and has spoken at NatCon in Washington, Orlando, Miami and Jerusalem (2026).
